name: waybill-fixture-member
description: Milestone 1271 FR-006 fixture member — SYNTHETIC names. Declares one development dependency that resolves to a locked registry package and one that uses a non-registry protocol, so the FR-006 diagnostic's FR-012 count is non-zero and therefore falsifiable. With an ABSENT root manifest the count is structurally zero and an assertion on it cannot fail; mutation testing proved that, which is why this fixture exists.
